annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Scroll-engine-specific surface. Window lifecycle and tile-request traffic for scrolling screens rides org.plasmazones.Tiling (the shared tiling-family pipeline, which routes per screen); this interface carries only the scrolling screen set and future columnar operations.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: List of screen IDs currently using the scrolling engine. The KWin effect uses it to stamp Mode 'scrolling' in window rule queries.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Emitted when the set of screens using the scrolling engine changes.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: List of screen IDs currently using the scrolling engine.
